200.description: The authorized request in its current stored state.

schema.description: Current authorized request with a response trace identifier.

request.description: Authorized request at its current stored state.

request_id.description: Server-assigned resource identifier, distinct from the response's trace request_id.

entity_type.description: Whether the request concerns a user or an agent.

entity_id.description: Canonical user ID or agent ID whose limit the request concerns.

client_id.description: Spend client for this user or agent request.

requester_user_id.description: Authenticated user who created the request.

business_justification.description: Stored explanation of why the increase is needed, when supplied.

period.description: Stored request month; resolution does not change this month.
period.title: PlatformRequestPeriod

resolved_by_user_id.description: User who resolved the request, when available.

approved_increase_amount.description: Stored additive approval amount, when available.
approved_increase_amount.title: PlatformRecordedApprovedAmount

scope.description: Approval scope derived from the stored ongoing flag, when available.
scope.title: PlatformRequestScope

resolution_target_id.description: Stored department or canonical IdP group ID, when available.

updated_at.description: Last stored update time; this is the resolution time for resolved requests.

allOf.description: Shared resolution target and identifier pairings.

oneOf.description: Omitted resolution fields for an unresolved request or PERIOD approval.

scope.description: Only PERIOD can omit the resolution target when scope is present.

oneOf.description: USER and ALL do not have a separate resolution target identifier.
GROUP and DEPARTMENT require their corresponding identifier.

resolution_target_id.description: Canonical IdP group ID or explicit department name.

allOf.title: PlatformRequestResolutionFields

request.title: PlatformLimitIncreaseRequest

request_id.description: Trace identifier, distinct from the resource ID.

schema.title: PlatformRequestResponse

400.description: Invalid input, with field-level validation details when available.

schema.description: Error response following RFC 9457, extended with `code` and `documentation_url` for machine-readable classification and self-service remediation.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored from the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.
detail.example: The provided cursor has expired. Start a new search to get a fresh cursor.

documentation_url.description: Direct URL to documentation for this error code.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

errors.description: Field-level validation problems, one entry per offending field.

items.description: Field-level validation problem for a single offending field.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the offending field.

detail.example: Must be one of: USER, GLEAN_AI.

items.title: PlatformProblemDetailError
